description: Hummingbird Property Services offer to let this six bedroom house presented in excellent condition. This is a very large detached house situated in the suburb townland of Ballintemple in Castlegar, Galway. Four of the large double bedrooms are ensuite. The expansive ground floor consists of sitting room with gas fire, kitchen and dining area, sun room, utility, hallway and three bedrooms. First floor has three bedrooms together with bathroom. The house has oil fired central heating. The house offers ample parking. Landscape contractor maintains grass year round. If you wish to enquire further with us at Hummingbird Property Services please reply directly to this advert.
